text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C at gains felt satisfying, but I should base future sales on my plan and risk—not on the pleasure of locking in a profit.","After several months of losses, doing nothing may have reflected reluctance to face losses; I should review each holding objectively rather than let its cost basis dictate my decision.","These price moves have not shown a dependable pattern, so I should not treat recent performance as a forecast; diversification and disciplined periodic reviews matter more."]}
